title.zh: 保留路线的在途请求完成

hypotheses.zh: 使用既有有限二元转译路线、正确积累摘要、捕获后保留的银行、有效头请求与连续 tick 调度。

correspondence.zh: 请求与其支持路线属于同一传递历史；正当请求含义、接入权限、写入原子性和物理对应另需成立。

detail.zh: 不证明原请求现在仍合宜；固定容量可以阻断接入，无任意调度下的实时完成保证。
detail.en: Does not show that the original request remains appropriate; finite capacity can block admission and arbitrary scheduling provides no deadline.

C33.title_zh: 多系统试验与父子关系
C33.claim_zh: 共同整体内可形成互补观察、可转移试验及分址纠正；系统群是否可作一个单位取决于实际组织、相关干预与共享依存。 关系接口可准确保留共同可行性，却仍遗漏依观察选择实现的条件；复合关系可被探测、修复并在内部修订中保持。 进一步区分完整端点关系与实际请求历史：逐段准备新路径，同时保护每个在途请求所引用的旧路径。
C33.claim_en: A shared whole can sustain complementary observations, transferable trials and separately addressed correction; grouping depends on actual organization, relevant interventions and shared dependencies. An exact relational feasibility interface can still omit observation-dependent realization; the composed relation can be probed, repaired and preserved through internal revision. Complete endpoint relations are further distinguished from actual request histories: prepare a new route incrementally while protecting each in-flight request’s referenced route.
C33.scope_zh: 条件说明与37项新定理／58项审计完成，继承19/31分列。独立误差增益与共同故障、局部汇总失效及联合负载反例并存；实际全局划分、试验传递与包含范围仍需证据。 关系接续再增39项定理／55项审计：任意有限翻译链及成对修订有正面证明，分开更新保留中途失败；实际协调实现与独立原创性未证。 版本接续新增33项定理／62项审计，继承62项定理／100项审计分列；4,512个状态、63,168条转移、100次交接及80次受控线程试验通过。保留原子取得与登记、生命周期及有限资源前提；既有网络更新获归属，实际AI对应与独立原创性未证。
C33.scope_en: Conditional account and 37 new theorems / 58 audits complete, with inherited 19/31 separate. Independent-error gains coexist with common-failure, summary and joint-load counterexamples; actual global boundaries, transfer and containment require evidence. Relational continuation adds 39 theorems / 55 audits: arbitrary finite translation chains and paired revisions have positive proofs, while split updates retain intermediate failure. Physical coordinated implementation and independent novelty remain open. Versioned continuation adds 33 theorems / 62 audits, with inherited 62 theorems / 100 audits separate; 4,512 states, 63,168 transitions, 100 handoffs and 80 controlled thread trials pass. Atomic acquisition with registration, lifetime and finite-resource premises remain; established network updates retain credit, while actual AI correspondence and independent novelty remain open.

M23.claim_zh: 接受更新不独自保持实际纠正入口；维护有真实代价，过滤后还须重算接续价值。有限期组合保留前缀入口并达到域内最优。 后续有限权重反例表明：局部修复还须能依实际观察执行；精确最优策略仍可有1/16不实断言风险。 主动观察还可破坏先前成立的风险分离；保证须覆盖后续观察，并保持实际记录与命令送达。 双通道协议实际取得并更新解码记录，保留旧入口直到新的当前记录就绪；匹配版本不独自保证记录真实。 终端纠正可实现当且仅当同一观察下有共同成功命令；相反隐藏解码阻断保证，受保护使用区间给出条件修复。 多系统互补观察与分址作用可以改变该边界；共同整体不排除有用试验，但局部成功不独自支持联合干预。 准确可能性接口不独自保持可观察纠正；复合探测与关系修复可起作用，保持复合关系允许内部继续变化。 进一步区分完整端点关系与实际请求历史：逐段准备新路径，同时保护每个在途请求所引用的旧路径。
M23.claim_en: Acceptance does not alone preserve correction access. Maintenance has a real cost, and filtering requires recomputed continuation values. Finite-horizon composition retains prefix access and attains the constrained optimum. A finite-weight counterexample shows that a local repair must be executable from available observations: exact optimality can retain a 1/16 false-assertion risk. Chosen sensing can invalidate an initially sufficient risk floor; guarantees must cover later observations and preserve usable records and command delivery. A two-channel protocol acquires and renews decoding records while retaining the old route until the new one is ready; matching versions alone do not establish record soundness. Terminal correction is realizable exactly when each observation admits a common successful command; conflicting hidden decoders obstruct guarantees, while a protected use interval supplies a conditional repair. Complementary observations and separately addressed actions across systems can change that boundary; a shared whole permits useful trials, but local success alone does not justify joint intervention. An exact possibility interface does not alone preserve observable correction; aggregate probes and relational repair can work, while preserving the composed relation allows continuing internal change. Complete endpoint relations are further distinguished from actual request histories: prepare a new route incrementally while protecting each in-flight request’s referenced route.
M23.scope_zh: 原34项定理／56项审计及12,960项比较保留；新增31项定理／54项审计，含随机策略最优界、可执行修复界及风险分离条件。论文对应经作者反审，形成具体前沿贡献供外部核查；独立验收、绝对原创性及实际 AI 优势未证。 再新增28项定理／40项审计、432项计划；如实对照与真实代价保留。后续23项定理／45项审计实现原子协议中任意前缀及无界调度的有限时刻安全，指定交接完成；472个状态、3,796条转移及100次交接通过。真实探测、全部变化受管理与可用通道仍为前提，实际AI停机未证。 后续34项定理／58项审计、63,504个案例及60次线程试验：任意有限记录不能消除已允许的最终歧义，随机最坏成功率至多1/2。底层方法已有先例；一般部署对应及独立原创性是当前墙。 多系统接续新增37项定理／58项审计，19/31继承分列；实际传递、试验包含及共同变化范围为新的对应墙。 关系接续新增39/55：成对修订的任意有限历史保持原纠正，拆开实施有中途失败；实际协调与动态分布式实现仍待证。 版本接续新增33项定理／62项审计，继承62项定理／100项审计分列；4,512个状态、63,168条转移、100次交接及80次受控线程试验通过。保留原子取得与登记、生命周期及有限资源前提；既有网络更新获归属，实际AI对应与独立原创性未证。
M23.scope_en: Original 34/56 proof package and 12,960 comparisons retained. Followup: 31 theorems / 54 audits, including randomized-policy optimality, executable repair bounds and a risk-floor condition. Explicit paper correspondence and author counterreview yield a concrete contribution for external scrutiny; independent acceptance, absolute priority and learned-AI advantage remain open. Further extension: 28 theorems / 40 audits and 432 plans, retaining safe controls and costs. A further 23 theorems / 45 audits realize prefix safety and safety at every finite point of unbounded atomic schedules, plus prescribed handoff completion; 472 states, 3,796 transitions and 100 handoffs pass. Faithful probing, mediated changes and channel availability remain premises; actual AI shutdown is unproved. Further 34 theorems / 58 audits, 63,504 cases and 60 thread trials: no finite transcript removes the admitted terminal ambiguity; randomized worst-case success is at most 1/2. Underlying methods are established; general deployment correspondence and independent novelty are the current walls. Plural-system continuation adds 37 theorems / 58 audits, with inherited 19/31 separate; actual transfer, trial containment and joint variation define the new correspondence wall. Relational extension adds 39/55: every finite history of paired revisions preserves the retained correction, but splitting an update fails between stages; physical coordination and dynamic distributed implementation remain unproved. Versioned continuation adds 33 theorems / 62 audits, with inherited 62 theorems / 100 audits separate; 4,512 states, 63,168 transitions, 100 handoffs and 80 controlled thread trials pass. Atomic acquisition with registration, lifetime and finite-resource premises remain; established network updates retain credit, while actual AI correspondence and independent novelty remain open.

links.label_zh: 可执行修复与前沿反例

F29.claim_en: Lean checks acceptance factorization, maintenance boundaries, stale-value failure, Bellman composition, observation uniformity and channel handoff. Adds a complete finite-weight counterexample, observation restriction, executable repair and approximation bounds. Adds Bayesian-consistent observation change, optimal sensing bounds, risk-floor failure and correction transport. Adds explicit probing, record invalidation, repeated-handoff invariants and four failure controls. Adds the observation-class common-action equivalence, transcript-certificate limit, randomized bounds and reserved test/use interval. Adds complementary observation, arbitrary duplication failure, independent/common error laws, parent-summary interventions and joint-load tests. Adds all-context feasibility equivalence, relational composition, arbitrary finite cycles and aggregate probes, paired-revision preservation and separation from observable realization. Complete endpoint relations are further distinguished from actual request histories: prepare a new route incrementally while protecting each in-flight request’s referenced route.
F29.scope_zh: 原34项定理／56项审计保留，新增31项定理／54项审计；Lean 4.30.0-rc2与固定Mathlib，标准逻辑依赖公开。论文对应单独核读，不由内核自动证明；未宣称普遍可纠正性。 本轮新增28项定理／40项审计，31/54继承分列；再新增23项定理／45项审计，原子双通道重复协议已完成；无条件活性、非原子实现和真实对应未证。 再新增34项定理／58项审计，两个模块无继承仓库证明；标准choice依赖公开。普通互斥为成功对照，未证完整双通道并发细化或实际AI停机。 本次37项新定理／58项新审计，含继承共89项；101及10,201个精确概率网格通过。未把条件独立和实际系统边界藏入数量定义。 本次再增39项定理／55项审计：38项空依赖、17项仅propext，无继承仓库证明；256对关系、4,096组三元组合、510个环路根值及1,284种成对修订通过。不是经验AI验证。 版本接续新增33项定理／62项审计，继承62项定理／100项审计分列；4,512个状态、63,168条转移、100次交接及80次受控线程试验通过。保留原子取得与登记、生命周期及有限资源前提；既有网络更新获归属，实际AI对应与独立原创性未证。
F29.scope_en: Original 34 theorems / 56 audits retained; 31 theorems / 54 audits added with Lean 4.30.0-rc2 and pinned Mathlib. Standard dependencies disclosed. External theorem correspondence is separately audited, not kernel-certified; no universal corrigibility claim. This round adds 28 theorems / 40 audits, with inherited 31/54 separate; a further 23 theorems / 45 audits complete an atomic two-channel repeated protocol. Unconditional liveness, non-atomic implementation and real correspondence remain unproved. A further 34 theorems / 58 audits in two modules with no inherited repository proofs; standard choice dependency disclosed. Ordinary mutexes are the successful control; full concurrent refinement of the two-channel model and actual AI shutdown are unproved. This round: 37 new theorems / 58 new audits, 89 including inheritance; 101 and 10,201 exact probability grid points pass. Independence and actual system boundaries are explicit obligations, not consequences of counting. Adds 39 theorems / 55 audits: 38 empty and 17 using only propext, with no inherited repository proofs. Checks cover 256 relation pairs, 4,096 composition triples, 510 cycle/root cases and 1,284 paired revisions. No empirical AI validation. Versioned continuation adds 33 theorems / 62 audits, with inherited 62 theorems / 100 audits separate; 4,512 states, 63,168 transitions, 100 handoffs and 80 controlled thread trials pass. Atomic acquisition with registration, lifetime and finite-resource premises remain; established network updates retain credit, while actual AI correspondence and independent novelty remain open.

M23.title_zh: 因应转化的条件与方向
M23.title_en: Conditions and direction of responsive transformation
M23.claim_zh: 接受更新不独自保持实际纠正入口；维护有真实代价，过滤后还须重算接续价值。有限期组合保留前缀入口并达到域内最优。 后续有限权重反例表明：局部修复还须能依实际观察执行；精确最优策略仍可有1/16不实断言风险。 主动观察还可破坏先前成立的风险分离；保证须覆盖后续观察，并保持实际记录与命令送达。 双通道协议实际取得并更新解码记录，保留旧入口直到新的当前记录就绪；匹配版本不独自保证记录真实。 终端纠正可实现当且仅当同一观察下有共同成功命令；相反隐藏解码阻断保证，受保护使用区间给出条件修复。 多系统互补观察与分址作用可以改变该边界；共同整体不排除有用试验，但局部成功不独自支持联合干预。 准确可能性接口不独自保持可观察纠正；复合探测与关系修复可起作用，保持复合关系允许内部继续变化。 进一步区分完整端点关系与实际请求历史：逐段准备新路径，同时保护每个在途请求所引用的旧路径。 9日澄清以因应转化为主词，研究认知与处境变化中的边界条件和方向；可纠正性保留为AI对齐读者桥接。
M23.claim_en: Acceptance does not alone preserve correction access. Maintenance has a real cost, and filtering requires recomputed continuation values. Finite-horizon composition retains prefix access and attains the constrained optimum. A finite-weight counterexample shows that a local repair must be executable from available observations: exact optimality can retain a 1/16 false-assertion risk. Chosen sensing can invalidate an initially sufficient risk floor; guarantees must cover later observations and preserve usable records and command delivery. A two-channel protocol acquires and renews decoding records while retaining the old route until the new one is ready; matching versions alone do not establish record soundness. Terminal correction is realizable exactly when each observation admits a common successful command; conflicting hidden decoders obstruct guarantees, while a protected use interval supplies a conditional repair. Complementary observations and separately addressed actions across systems can change that boundary; a shared whole permits useful trials, but local success alone does not justify joint intervention. An exact possibility interface does not alone preserve observable correction; aggregate probes and relational repair can work, while preserving the composed relation allows continuing internal change. Complete endpoint relations are further distinguished from actual request histories: prepare a new route incrementally while protecting each in-flight request’s referenced route. The 9 October clarification uses responsive transformation as the primary term, studying conditions and direction through changing understanding and circumstances; corrigibility remains an AI-alignment reader bridge.
M23.scope_zh: 原34项定理／56项审计及12,960项比较保留；新增31项定理／54项审计，含随机策略最优界、可执行修复界及风险分离条件。论文对应经作者反审，形成具体前沿贡献供外部核查；独立验收、绝对原创性及实际 AI 优势未证。 再新增28项定理／40项审计、432项计划；如实对照与真实代价保留。后续23项定理／45项审计实现原子协议中任意前缀及无界调度的有限时刻安全，指定交接完成；472个状态、3,796条转移及100次交接通过。真实探测、全部变化受管理与可用通道仍为前提，实际AI停机未证。 后续34项定理／58项审计、63,504个案例及60次线程试验：任意有限记录不能消除已允许的最终歧义，随机最坏成功率至多1/2。底层方法已有先例；一般部署对应及独立原创性是当前墙。 多系统接续新增37项定理／58项审计，19/31继承分列；实际传递、试验包含及共同变化范围为新的对应墙。 关系接续新增39/55：成对修订的任意有限历史保持原纠正，拆开实施有中途失败；实际协调与动态分布式实现仍待证。 版本接续新增33项定理／62项审计，继承62项定理／100项审计分列；4,512个状态、63,168条转移、100次交接及80次受控线程试验通过。保留原子取得与登记、生命周期及有限资源前提；既有网络更新获归属，实际AI对应与独立原创性未证。 本次为解释修订，无新数学结果；既有条件证明、处境变化反例及仍有根据的责任保留，不把无条件保证设为方向完成门槛。
M23.scope_en: Original 34/56 proof package and 12,960 comparisons retained. Followup: 31 theorems / 54 audits, including randomized-policy optimality, executable repair bounds and a risk-floor condition. Explicit paper correspondence and author counterreview yield a concrete contribution for external scrutiny; independent acceptance, absolute priority and learned-AI advantage remain open. Further extension: 28 theorems / 40 audits and 432 plans, retaining safe controls and costs. A further 23 theorems / 45 audits realize prefix safety and safety at every finite point of unbounded atomic schedules, plus prescribed handoff completion; 472 states, 3,796 transitions and 100 handoffs pass. Faithful probing, mediated changes and channel availability remain premises; actual AI shutdown is unproved. Further 34 theorems / 58 audits, 63,504 cases and 60 thread trials: no finite transcript removes the admitted terminal ambiguity; randomized worst-case success is at most 1/2. Underlying methods are established; general deployment correspondence and independent novelty are the current walls. Plural-system continuation adds 37 theorems / 58 audits, with inherited 19/31 separate; actual transfer, trial containment and joint variation define the new correspondence wall. Relational extension adds 39/55: every finite history of paired revisions preserves the retained correction, but splitting an update fails between stages; physical coordination and dynamic distributed implementation remain unproved. Versioned continuation adds 33 theorems / 62 audits, with inherited 62 theorems / 100 audits separate; 4,512 states, 63,168 transitions, 100 handoffs and 80 controlled thread trials pass. Atomic acquisition with registration, lifetime and finite-resource premises remain; established network updates retain credit, while actual AI correspondence and independent novelty remain open. This is an interpretive revision with no new mathematical result. Existing conditional proofs, changed-circumstance failures and warranted responsibilities remain; unconditional assurance is not the direction’s completion gate.

F29.claim_zh: 精确接受分解、维护界、旧价值反例、Bellman 组合、观察一致性及通道交接均经 Lean 检查。 新增完整有限权重反例、观察限制、可执行修复及近似界。 新增Bayes一致观察变化、主动取得信息的最优界、风险分离失效及纠正传递。 新增记录探测、版本失效、重复交接不变量及四类失败见证。 新增观察类共同动作充要条件、记录证书限制、随机界及测试—使用保留区间。 新增互补观察、任意复制失败、独立／共同误差、父汇总干预与联合负载检验。 新增全情境可行性等价、关系组合、任意有限环路及复合探测、成对修订保持与可观察实现分离。 进一步区分完整端点关系与实际请求历史：逐段准备新路径，同时保护每个在途请求所引用的旧路径。 9日澄清以因应转化为主词，研究认知与处境变化中的边界条件和方向；可纠正性保留为AI对齐读者桥接。
F29.claim_en: Lean checks acceptance factorization, maintenance boundaries, stale-value failure, Bellman composition, observation uniformity and channel handoff. Adds a complete finite-weight counterexample, observation restriction, executable repair and approximation bounds. Adds Bayesian-consistent observation change, optimal sensing bounds, risk-floor failure and correction transport. Adds explicit probing, record invalidation, repeated-handoff invariants and four failure controls. Adds the observation-class common-action equivalence, transcript-certificate limit, randomized bounds and reserved test/use interval. Adds complementary observation, arbitrary duplication failure, independent/common error laws, parent-summary interventions and joint-load tests. Adds all-context feasibility equivalence, relational composition, arbitrary finite cycles and aggregate probes, paired-revision preservation and separation from observable realization. Complete endpoint relations are further distinguished from actual request histories: prepare a new route incrementally while protecting each in-flight request’s referenced route. The 9 October clarification uses responsive transformation as the primary term, studying conditions and direction through changing understanding and circumstances; corrigibility remains an AI-alignment reader bridge.

F29.scope_en: Original 34 theorems / 56 audits retained; 31 theorems / 54 audits added with Lean 4.30.0-rc2 and pinned Mathlib. Standard dependencies disclosed. External theorem correspondence is separately audited, not kernel-certified; no universal corrigibility claim. This round adds 28 theorems / 40 audits, with inherited 31/54 separate; a further 23 theorems / 45 audits complete an atomic two-channel repeated protocol. Unconditional liveness, non-atomic implementation and real correspondence remain unproved. A further 34 theorems / 58 audits in two modules with no inherited repository proofs; standard choice dependency disclosed. Ordinary mutexes are the successful control; full concurrent refinement of the two-channel model and actual AI shutdown are unproved. This round: 37 new theorems / 58 new audits, 89 including inheritance; 101 and 10,201 exact probability grid points pass. Independence and actual system boundaries are explicit obligations, not consequences of counting. Adds 39 theorems / 55 audits: 38 empty and 17 using only propext, with no inherited repository proofs. Checks cover 256 relation pairs, 4,096 composition triples, 510 cycle/root cases and 1,284 paired revisions. No empirical AI validation. Versioned continuation adds 33 theorems / 62 audits, with inherited 62 theorems / 100 audits separate; 4,512 states, 63,168 transitions, 100 handoffs and 80 controlled thread trials pass. Atomic acquisition with registration, lifetime and finite-resource premises remain; established network updates retain credit, while actual AI correspondence and independent novelty remain open.
